1879097207.Skill_Desc: Summons a little rabbit-friend to brighten your day.

1879182839.Skill_Desc: Air continually swirls around your target ally, inflicting damage on any who strike it.\n\nCannot be used on self.

1879198327.Skill_Desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208439.Skill_Desc: A pony laden with the spoils of a treasure hunt!
1879208439.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from the Huge Treasure Cache in the Treasure Hunt.

1879214583.Skill_Desc: A quick attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879219447.Skill_Desc: A Rune-keeper may compose a terrible essay of burning fury to bring to bear against their foes.

1879234295.Skill_Desc: A damaging shot that also restores the Hunter's Morale.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879240695.Skill_Desc: A simple passing attack that increases attacking strength when successful.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879242103.Skill_Desc: Remove all CC and provide immunity to CC

1879248375.Skill_Desc: Targeting the most vital areas of an opponent is difficult enough. While mounted it takes increased skill and effort; maybe even a little patience and luck, but when you strike with this skill the results are destructive.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This skill has a reduced chance to hit unless the trait Shoot to Kill is active.</rgb>

1879252599.Skill_Desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879271287.Skill_Desc: A mighty roar that damages surrounding opponents, this skill is enabled by taking several hits while Unbreakable is active.

1879274103.Skill_Desc: With preparation, some Wardens can throw their Javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.\n\nFor every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.
1879274103.Skill_Name: Snap Shot - Javelin of Deadly Force - Fire

1879297399.Skill_Desc: Folca executes a vicious puncturing spear strike to a single enemy.

1879318135.Skill_Desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

1879319927.Skill_Desc: You prefer to command the enemies' attention in battle and know how to instigate your opponent, generating threat over time.

1879320183.Skill_Desc: Bring down your weapon with great force upon your foe.

1879339127.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Henneth Annûn.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879375479.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879406583.Skill_Desc: Summons a swarm of probably friendly bees to keep you company.
1879406583.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Mists of Wilderland.

1879409271.Skill_Desc: Blow the horn to summon Ausma to your side.

1879418743.Skill_Desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a pipe pattern.

1879449847.Skill_Desc: Knocks an enemy down for a short duration.

1879467255.Skill_Desc: A pot filled with a corrosive substance. Creates a pool of acid on the ground that burns through armour and hide alike.

1879470583.Skill_Desc: A follow up strike that deals more damage and has a greater chance to critically hit.\n\nEnables Anchored Thrust.

1879491063.Skill_Desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.
1879491063.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability from 'A Special Celebration - Year Nineteen'.

1879495159.Skill_Desc: A crate of fine yet strong smelling cheese. Place this down and see who is adventurous enough to try some.
1879495159.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: A crate of fine yet strong smelling cheese. Place this down and see who is adventurous enough to try some.

1879497719.Skill_Desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506679.Skill_Desc: Call upon the stallion's spirit to restore the Power of yourself or a fellow.

1879508727.Skill_Desc: You're able to quickly return to Jiret-menêsh in An Shêru in Mûr Ghala. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879520631.Skill_Desc: Summons a hard working herding dog to accompany you on your travels.
1879520631.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available by completing the quest 'Head of the Herd'.

1879528567.Skill_Desc: Devoted to the Umbral Pall, infused by a Synergy, your target expels shadows, damaging nearby enemies and afflicting them with an effect corresponding to the devotion of your most recent attack.
